These disclosures address hardware/software for inference and edge computing compute, but do not discuss wireless connectivity technologies, FWA solutions, or 5G network optimization for enterprise branches.

While these technologies may run on edge infrastructure, the disclosures do not describe wireless access solutions, 5G connectivity, or fixed wireless broadband services.

comparisons.peer_summary: Advances in 5G and Wi-Fi technologies are driving demand for edge networking products, enabling operators to replace wired broadband and supporting increased connected device density.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and QCOM disclose Fixed Wireless Access (FWA) or fixed wireless connectivity as a key application of their 5G and edge networking technologies, specifically noting the ability to replace or optimize traditional wired broadband connections for enterprise and business use cases. AVGO describes its Fixed Wireless Access solution as providing 'reliable 5G connectivity to businesses and enterprise branches at the edge' to optimize the network through intelligence. Similarly, QCOM highlights that '5G provides the flexibility to support both mobile and fixed wireless users... enabling operators to replace traditional "last-mile" wired broadband connections,' driving demand for edge networking products.

sentences.text: • Fixed Wireless Access: This solution provides enterprises with reliable 5G connectivity to businesses and enterprise branches at the edge while optimizing the network through intelligence and network programmability.

5G provides the flexibility to support both mobile and fixed wireless users with the delivery of high-speed, low-latency connections, enabling operators to replace traditional "last-mile" wired broadband connections.
Advances in wireless technology are helping to drive demand for edge networking products (including mobile broadband and wireless access points).
